hypothesis_text: Theme altcoins exhibiting extreme positive funding rates (funding_extreme) experience short-term downward price reversal over 1h to 4h horizons when aggressive taker buying subsides and takers begin selling, triggering an economic unwind of leveraged carry long positions.
narrative: When crypto perpetual markets experience massive retail enthusiasm, funding rates on meme and theme altcoins such as DOGE spike to extreme positive levels (here 0.1146% per 8 hours, annualized over 125%). Carry traders and long speculators incur severe ongoing financing drag. So long as aggressive taker buyers continue buying into the order book, the price can remain elevated. However, as taker buyer flow exhausts and flips to net selling (captured by taker_buy_ratio_1h falling below median, and isolated via gate_low), the economic carry becomes immediately unprofitable and unsustainable. Longs are forced to close or liquidate their inventory to stem bleeding from funding payments. This forced exit creates temporary price impact and subsequent downward mean-reversion over 1h to 4h. The effect is amplified when recent 4h open interest expanded (gate_high on oi_change_pct_4h), ensuring sufficient leveraged inventory exists that must be closed.
research_rationale: The anchor signal A4_DOGEUSDT_562 was selected from 177 funding_extreme signals on the alt_theme panel due to its exceptional statistical significance (z=28.04, p=4.73e-173, n_effective=177), clean pit data provenance, and physical plausibility during the December 2024 altcoin rally. In inspect_catalog gene_knowledge, the gene prior explicitly recommends pairing funding_extreme with taker_buy_ratio_1h as a trigger (role: trigger, direction: opposite_side, kind_if_anchor_up: gate_low) and oi_change_pct_4h as exposure (role: exposure, direction: high, kind: gate_high); our composition plan directly adopts these exact prior recommendations. In cemetery analysis for funding_rate_zscore_30d, 785 out of 949 historical evidential kills were at T0.04-IC-STAT due to unconditioned dense formulas suffering from low signal-to-noise across ordinary market regimes, while the only horizon with consistent survival was 1h (7 passes) and 2h (4 passes), with 0 passes at 4h. Our design directly addresses these historical failure modes by: (a) restricting execution via expression_gate and gate_low/gate_high event filters so the strategy trades only during genuine carry exhaustion rather than continuous bars; and (b) focusing the predicted horizon band on 1h to 4h where carry unwind dynamics operate. What the evidence does NOT show: the descriptive lakehouse scan only establishes point-in-time extreme funding and order flow co-occurrence; it does not measure forward returns or certify out-of-sample alpha, which remains strictly subject to Layer 2.5 T0/T1 verification.
